people.name: Hanan
people.line: Son of Igdaliah, associated with the Rechabites.

people.name: Igdaliah
people.line: A man of God during Jeremiah's time.

people.name: Maaseiah
people.line: Ancestor of Jaazaniah; associated with the Rechabites

people.name: Shallum
people.line: Father of Maaseiah, keeper of the threshold

translations.web: and I brought them into Yahweh’s house, into the room of the sons of Hanan the son of Igdaliah, the man of God, which was by the room of the princes, which was above the room of Maaseiah the son of Shallum, the keeper of the threshold.
translations.bsb: and I brought them into the house of the LORD, to a chamber occupied by the sons of Hanan son of Igdaliah, a man of God. This room was near the chamber of the officials, which was above the chamber of Maaseiah son of Shallum the doorkeeper.
translations.kjv: And I brought them into the house of the LORD, into the chamber of the sons of Hanan, the son of Igdaliah, a man of God, which was by the chamber of the princes, which was above the chamber of Maaseiah the son of Shallum, the keeper of the door:
translations.asv: and I brought them into the house of Jehovah, into the chamber of the sons of Hanan the son of Igdaliah, the man of God, which was by the chamber of the princes, which was above the chamber of Maaseiah the son of Shallum, the keeper of the threshold.
